SELECT
  c.razon_social                                                      AS empresa,
  c.rut                                                               AS empresa_rut,
  c.bps_empresa_nro                                                   AS empresa_bps,
  c.bps_grupo                                                         AS grupo,
  c.bps_subgrupo                                                      AS subgrupo,
  COALESCE(emp.cedula, u.identity_document)                          AS ci,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp.nombres||' '||emp.apellidos), ''), u.name) AS nombre,
  emp.numero_bps                                                      AS historia_laboral_bps,
  emp.fecha_ingreso                                                   AS fecha_ingreso,
  pe.contract_type                                                    AS vinculo,
  pe.fonasa_family_situation                                          AS situacion_fonasa,
  pe.gross_salary                                                     AS salario_nominal,
  pe.bps_employee                                                     AS montepio_obrero,
  pe.bps_employer                                                     AS montepio_patronal,
  pe.fonasa_employee                                                  AS fonasa_obrero,
  pe.fonasa_employer                                                  AS fonasa_patronal,
  COALESCE(pe.frl_employee, 0)                                        AS frl_obrero,
  COALESCE(pe.frl_employer, 0)                                        AS frl_patronal,
  pe.aguinaldo_provision                                              AS provision_aguinaldo,
  pe.vacation_provision                                               AS provision_vacacional,
  pe.total_employer_cost                                             AS costo_total_patronal,
  pp.period_year, pp.period_month
FROM payroll_entries pe
JOIN payroll_periods pp ON pe.payroll_period_id = pp.id
JOIN users u ON pe.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN clinic c ON c.id = pp.clinic_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.* FROM payroll_employees e
  WHERE e.user_id = pe.user_id AND e.clinic_id = pp.clinic_id
  ORDER BY e.activo DESC, e.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) emp ON true
WHERE pp.id = $1::uuid
  AND pe.contract_type IN ('dependencia','pasante','termino','suplencia')
ORDER BY nombre

SELECT
  COALESCE(emp.cedula, u.identity_document)                          AS ci,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp.nombres||' '||emp.apellidos), ''), u.name) AS nombre,
  SUM(pe.gross_salary)                                               AS renta_computable,
  SUM(pe.bps_employee + pe.fonasa_employee + COALESCE(pe.frl_employee,0)) AS aportes_personales,
  SUM(pe.irpf_withholding)                                           AS irpf_retenido
FROM payroll_entries pe
JOIN payroll_periods pp ON pe.payroll_period_id = pp.id
JOIN users u ON pe.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.* FROM payroll_employees e
  WHERE e.user_id = pe.user_id AND e.clinic_id = pp.clinic_id
  ORDER BY e.activo DESC, e.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) emp ON true
WHERE pp.period_year = $1::integer
  AND ($2::integer IS NULL OR pp.clinic_id = $2::integer)
  AND pe.status IN ('approved','paid')
GROUP BY COALESCE(emp.cedula, u.identity_document),
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp.nombres||' '||emp.apellidos), ''), u.name)
ORDER BY nombre

SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp.nombres||' '||emp.apellidos), ''), u.name) AS nombre,
  COALESCE(emp.cedula, u.identity_document)                          AS ci,
  emp.fecha_ingreso                                                  AS fecha_ingreso,
  cat.codigo                                                         AS categoria_codigo,
  cat.nombre                                                         AS categoria,
  empl.tipo_contrato                                                 AS vinculo,
  empl.jornada_horas_semanales                                       AS jornada_semanal,
  pe.hours_worked                                                    AS horas_mes,
  pe.sessions_count                                                  AS sesiones,
  pe.gross_salary                                                    AS salario_nominal,
  pp.period_year, pp.period_month
FROM payroll_entries pe
JOIN payroll_periods pp ON pe.payroll_period_id = pp.id
JOIN users u ON pe.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.* FROM payroll_employees e
  WHERE e.user_id = pe.user_id AND e.clinic_id = pp.clinic_id
  ORDER BY e.activo DESC, e.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) emp ON true
LEFT JOIN payroll_employments empl ON empl.id = pe.payroll_employment_id
LEFT JOIN payroll_categories cat ON cat.id = empl.category_id
WHERE pp.id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY nombre

SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp.nombres||' '||emp.apellidos), ''), u.name) AS nombre,
  COALESCE(emp.cedula, u.identity_document)                          AS ci,
  emp.banco                                                          AS banco,
  emp.cuenta_banco                                                   AS cuenta,
  pe.net_salary                                                      AS importe,
  pe.currency                                                        AS moneda
FROM payroll_entries pe
JOIN payroll_periods pp ON pe.payroll_period_id = pp.id
JOIN users u ON pe.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.* FROM payroll_employees e
  WHERE e.user_id = pe.user_id AND e.clinic_id = pp.clinic_id
  ORDER BY e.activo DESC, e.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) emp ON true
WHERE pp.id = $1::uuid
  AND pe.status IN ('approved','paid')
  AND pe.net_salary > 0
  AND emp.cuenta_banco IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY nombre

SELECT
  pp.period_year, pp.period_month,
  COUNT(pe.id)::integer                                              AS liquidaciones,
  SUM(pe.gross_salary)                                               AS total_salarios_brutos,
  SUM(pe.bps_employee)                                               AS total_bps_obrero,
  SUM(pe.fonasa_employee)                                            AS total_fonasa_obrero,
  SUM(COALESCE(pe.frl_employee,0))                                   AS total_frl_obrero,
  SUM(pe.irpf_withholding)                                           AS total_irpf,
  SUM(pe.total_deductions)                                           AS total_deducciones,
  SUM(pe.net_salary)                                                 AS total_salarios_netos,
  SUM(pe.bps_employer)                                               AS total_bps_patronal,
  SUM(pe.fonasa_employer)                                            AS total_fonasa_patronal,
  SUM(COALESCE(pe.frl_employer,0))                                   AS total_frl_patronal,
  SUM(COALESCE(pe.bse_employer,0))                                   AS total_bse_patronal,
  SUM(pe.aguinaldo_provision)                                        AS total_provision_aguinaldo,
  SUM(pe.vacation_provision)                                         AS total_provision_vacacional,
  SUM(pe.total_employer_cost)                                        AS costo_total_empresa
FROM payroll_entries pe
JOIN payroll_periods pp ON pe.payroll_period_id = pp.id
WHERE pp.id = $1::uuid
GROUP BY pp.period_year, pp.period_month

SELECT
  pe.id AS entry_id,
  c.razon_social                                                     AS empresa,
  c.rut                                                              AS empresa_rut,
  c.bps_empresa_nro                                                  AS empresa_bps,
  c.domicilio_fiscal                                                 AS empresa_domicilio,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp.nombres||' '||emp.apellidos), ''), u.name) AS nombre,
  COALESCE(emp.cedula, u.identity_document)                         AS ci,
  emp.numero_bps                                                     AS numero_bps,
  emp.banco                                                          AS banco,
  emp.cuenta_banco                                                   AS cuenta,
  emp.fecha_ingreso                                                  AS fecha_ingreso,
  cat.nombre                                                         AS categoria,
  pe.contract_type                                                   AS vinculo,
  pp.period_year, pp.period_month,
  pe.sessions_count, pe.hours_worked,
  pe.hours_extra_habiles, pe.hours_extra_feriados,
  pe.gross_salary, pe.bps_employee, pe.fonasa_employee,
  COALESCE(pe.frl_employee,0)                                        AS frl_employee,
  pe.irpf_withholding, pe.other_deductions, pe.total_deductions,
  pe.net_salary,
  pe.bps_employer, pe.fonasa_employer,
  pe.aguinaldo_provision, pe.vacation_provision,
  pe.currency, pe.status
FROM payroll_entries pe
JOIN payroll_periods pp ON pe.payroll_period_id = pp.id
JOIN users u ON pe.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN clinic c ON c.id = pp.clinic_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.* FROM payroll_employees e
  WHERE e.user_id = pe.user_id AND e.clinic_id = pp.clinic_id
  ORDER BY e.activo DESC, e.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) emp ON true
LEFT JOIN payroll_employments empl ON empl.id = pe.payroll_employment_id
LEFT JOIN payroll_categories cat ON cat.id = empl.category_id
WHERE pp.id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY nombre

SELECT
  c.name  AS clinic_name,
  pp.period_year, pp.period_month,
  COUNT(pe.id)::integer         AS headcount,
  SUM(pe.gross_salary)          AS total_bruto,
  SUM(pe.total_employer_cost)   AS costo_total
FROM payroll_entries pe
JOIN payroll_periods pp ON pe.payroll_period_id = pp.id
JOIN clinic c ON pp.clinic_id = c.id
WHERE pp.period_year = $1::integer
  AND ($2::integer IS NULL OR pp.period_month = $2::integer)
GROUP BY c.name, pp.period_year, pp.period_month
ORDER BY pp.period_month, c.name
